landing.h1: One market. Two ways to trade.
landing.intro: Buy the asset or trade its price with leverage. Built for Robinhood Chain.
landing.step1Body: Choose an asset and see what you can do with it.
landing.step2Body: Buy the asset, or open a leveraged position.
landing.step3Body: See fees and risk before you confirm.
landing.testnetBanner: Testnet only. These assets have no real-world value.

leverageConsent.title: Before you trade with leverage
leverageConsent.body: Leverage increases both gains and losses. Your position can be liquidated if its margin falls too low.
leverageConsent.ack1: I understand I can lose the collateral in this position.
leverageConsent.ack2: I understand the liquidation price may change as funding and fees accrue.
leverageConsent.ack3: I understand the displayed liquidation price is an estimate, not a guaranteed exit.
